UI_HZ_EmitInterval_tip: Sound, dispatch, renew and navigation share one beat: one pile per N real seconds. Lower = snappier and costlier; 2s is the compromise.
UI_HZ_DebugMode_tip: Writes a debug snapshot every 10 game minutes and draws a HUD.
UI_HZ_RotMin_tip: Lower bound of the delay before a corpse starts rotting (game hours). Even unrotten corpses attract zombies in a small radius that scales with pile size.
UI_HZ_StinkFullHours_tip: Game hours of rot age needed for the smell to reach full strength.
UI_HZ_CountFull_tip: Corpse count at which the count bonus reaches its maximum.
UI_HZ_MaxEaters_tip: Max zombies eating per tile. Too high and they jam each other and fail to enter the eating state.
UI_HZ_BoneHours_tip: Time (game hours) for an uneaten corpse to be consumed by the 'meta zombies', so unreachable corpses do not waste performance.
UI_HZ_ReloadMod_tip: Reload the mod's Lua files without restarting the game.
UI_HZ_PileSize_tip: Pile grid size: corpses in the same area merge into one pile of this size.
UI_HZ_EatMinutes_tip: Game minutes one zombie needs to finish one corpse.
UI_HZ_FakeDeadFood_tip: When on, fake-dead (revivable) corpses are also food and are removed from the pile when they reanimate. Keep off for normal play.
UI_HZ_SatDigestHours_tip: Digestion speed (game hours per point): controls satiety loss and nutrition gain. Both cap at 5.
UI_HZ_NutPerSat_tip: Nutrition gained per digested satiety point. Nutrition drives the five stats (health/strength/speed/sight/hearing), which grow randomly as nutrition rises.
UI_HZ_NutDecayDay_tip: Nutrition lost per game day. Lower nutrition weakens the five stats; doubles when satiety is 0.
UI_HZ_RotMax_tip: Upper bound of the delay before a corpse starts rotting (game hours), randomised between min and max.
UI_HZ_VolumeMin_tip: Minimum smell concentration. Higher concentration makes zombies focus more and may ignore footsteps, scent and even gunshots.
UI_HZ_WeightRadiusAge_tip: Weight of rot age in the radius blend; the count weight is automatically 1 − this value.
UI_HZ_WeightVolumeCount_tip: Weight of corpse count in the volume blend; the age weight is automatically 1 − this value.
UI_HZ_EatDistance_tip: How close a zombie must be to a corpse to start eating
UI_HZ_BlockMs_tip: After a release, how long before the same zombie can be sent to the same corpse
UI_HZ_LongBlockMs_tip: Long cooldown after failing to reach a corpse for 30s
UI_HZ_PendingRetryMs_tip: Retry interval when the corpse's square is not loaded yet
UI_HZ_PendingGiveupMs_tip: How long to keep retrying before abandoning the corpse
UI_HZ_DebugScanRadius_tip: Radius of the zombie/corpse listing in debug snapshots
UI_HZ_DebugSnapMinutes_tip: How often to write a debug snapshot
UI_HZ_Snap_tip: Writes internal state to Zomboid/Lua/HZ_debug/ every debug interval. Diagnostics only; keep off for normal play.
UI_HZ_RotRandom_tip: On: random between Min and Max; Off: always use Min (all piles rot identically).
UI_HZ_SnapPerPile_tip: Position snapshot = action interval x N (default 2 = 4s). Fresher table = more accurate dispatch, older = cheaper. Integer multiple, so it never drifts against the action beat.
UI_HZ_FakeDeadStarved_tip: Zombies at zero nutrition (<=0.01) lie down looking like corpses and get up when the player comes close. Once per starvation cycle; re-armed only after nutrition climbs back above 0.5.
